rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A GitHub automation server that implements an approval gate pattern for safe AI-driven repository operations. Every write operation (creating issues, opening pull requests, adding comments) creates a pending action that requires explicit admin approval before execution. Features role-based access control with operator and admin roles, comprehensive logging with correlation IDs, rate limiting, retry logic with exponential backoff, and repository access restrictions.
